title.value: Robust prior-biased acquisition function for human-in-the-loop Bayesian optimization
title.justification: The title is stated at the beginning of the paper, providing a direct description of the paper's content.
title.quote: Robust prior-biased acquisition function for human-in-the-loop Bayesian optimization

analysis.description: This paper presents a new method, α-πBO, to improve Bayesian Optimization (BO) by integrating domain knowledge effectively and robustly through a fixed-weight prior-biased acquisition function. It evaluates the method's performance across multiple tasks and prior knowledge qualities, showing how it outperforms existing methods by leveraging good prior information while maintaining robustness against misleading data.

type.justification: The paper presents experimental results comparing α-πBO with other Bayesian optimization methods across various datasets and scenarios.
type.quote: Comprehensive investigation across diverse task conditions and prior quality levels revealed that our method, α-πBO, surpasses Vanilla BO when provided with insights of good quality while maintaining robustness against misleading information.
